title: Merge K Sorted Lists
goal: Solve Merge K Sorted Lists: Use a min-heap over current list heads to repeatedly pick the global minimum in O(N log k).
strategy: Use a min-heap over current list heads to repeatedly pick the global minimum in O(N log k).
edgeCases: Some input lists may be empty; every chosen minimum must expose only that list’s next candidate.
inputRules: Input must be list of lists
Each list must be an array
